entry.content: ... that Coscinodon lawianus is one of only two species of moss only found in continental Antarctica?

entry.title: Alexey Davydov (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that LGBTQ activist Alexey Davydov became the first person to be charged with violating Russia's 2013 anti-gay law after he displayed a sign that read "being gay is normal" at a children's library?
